name: Raycast
author: T3lluz
description: Install and run extensions from the Raycast store: ray dad jokes

setup.summary: Installs the pinned react and react-reconciler packages from the npm registry into ~/.local/share/keystroke/raycast/runtime. npm ci checks the lockfile hashes. Nothing else is downloaded.

commands.title: Raycast extensions
commands.summary: Search the Raycast store, install an extension, and run its commands
